Topic: 77 K N₂ sorption (BET / pore sizes) + TGA defect quantification
1. N₂ physisorption: ASAP 2460. All samples degassed in situ at 150 °C for 4 h.
- Zr-BDC-01: Type I; steep rise at P/P₀ < 0.05, then plateau; no hysteresis.
NLDFT: 0.85 nm micropore peak; minor 0.60 nm cage-window contribution.
- Zr-BDC-02: Type I+IV; higher low-pressure uptake than 01.
(1.85 nm defect cages, called mesopores in these notes).
- Zr-BDC-03: low-pressure uptake drops; slow high-pressure rise with hysteresis.
BET = 740 m²/g; V_total = 0.39 cm³/g; V_micro = 0.21 cm³/g.
Weak 0.85 nm peak + broad 2.6–3.2 nm disordered pores.
60 eq TFA / 160 °C over-etching + 180 °C activation -> local micropore collapse.
Final ZrO₂ residue normalized to 100%; use 450–550 °C linker-combustion step.
Ideal: 6 BDC linkers per Zr₆ cluster.
- Zr-BDC-01: T_d = 515 °C; linker/cluster = 5.70 -> 0.30 missing linkers / Zr₆ (nearly ideal).
- Zr-BDC-02: T_d = 490 °C; linker/cluster = 4.62 -> 1.38 missing linkers / Zr₆ (many unsaturated Zr⁴⁺ Lewis acid sites).
Apparent missing linkers = 2.35 / Zr₆ (poor connectivity / low thermal stability!).

- Zr-BDC-03: Qsto = 29.1 kJ/mol; IAST = 21.0. [批注，对应Zr-BDC-03：some defect affinity remains, but micropore collapse lowers capacity/selectivity.]
298 K; CO₂/N₂ = 15/85; 20 mL/min; packed mass 0.50 g.
- Dry: N₂ breakthrough 1.2 – 1.5 min/g for all samples.
02: 94.6% retention; competing water at Zr sites. 150 °C regeneration fully restores capacity; framework intact.
03: uptake LOSS 38.5% → only 61.5% retained; BET falls to 430 m²/g! Irreversible Zr-O-C hydrolysis / collapse (2.35 missing linkers per cluster).
